summary: Retain email headers and quoted history as reviewable evidence while completing them locally before extraction batching so only eligible current email content reaches the model.
decision_refs: Active user goal to improve efficiency and accuracy for RFI, Submittal and Email content
Measured synthetic baseline where one RFI reply produced separate header, current-body and quoted-history extraction batches
Existing deterministic publication rule that rejects email headers and quoted history as current material or QA evidence
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly requires continued efficiency and accuracy improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: The measured three-to-one reduction applies to the tested reply shape and is not a universal email reduction ratio.
Current body evidence still uses the normal model path and remains subject to provider latency, cost and contract validation.
Mailbox synchronization, semantic thread inference and automatic attachment recursion remain unsupported.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer email or paid provider was used.
